snippet.title: ASMR Psalm 1-16/ 시편 1-16장 (Bible Reading to help you sleep)
snippet.description:
💖 Hi friends! I hope you guys are staying safe and healthy. 
So... crazy times eh? hahaha I cannot believe it's already July of 2020, wth, where did the time go? This year has been a strange one... I can only guess that so many of you guys have been affected by the current state of the world. With the U.S. elections coming up, COVID-19, the racial issues in the States, and many other world crises that I don't even know about, I hope this video can provide a way to help you guys fall asleep... and I hope and pray that in the midst of difficulties, you can be reminded to look up to the one God who cares for you and wants you to come to His feet and find rest in His loving presence. The past few days, I have been reminded that God desires our childlike emotions and wants us to draw to Him even when we feel like complaining and can't always praise him. I am so thankful that God has allowed me to provide a place where I can share the most intimate and cherished parts of myself. While I may not know you guys personally, so many of you guys kindly update me on your lives and I feel like I am longtime friends with a lot of you. Thank you for making me feel comfortable enough to share these moments with you and for always being the most drama-free, loyal, wonderful, kind-hearted subscribers a gal could ever wish for!

- "But as for me, I watch in hope for the Lord, I wait for God my Savior; my God will hear me." - Micah 7:7
- "That is why, for Christ's sake, I delight in weaknesses, in insults, in hardships, in persecutions, in difficulties. For when I am weak, then I am strong." - 2 Corinthians 12:10
- "I called on your name, Lord, from the depths of the pit. You heard my plea: 'Do not close your ears to my cry for relief.' You came near when I called you, and You said, 'Do not fear.'" - Lamentations 3:55-57
- "The Lord will fulfill his purpose for me; Your steadfast love, O Lord, endures forever. Do not forsake the work of your hands." - Psalm 138:8

With love,
Nicole/ Pigsbum
------------------------------------------
💖 안녕하세요~ 위에 뭔 센치한 소설을 쓰다 보니..이게 너무 길어지네요;;;
짧게 말하자면, 요즘 세상이 참 힘든거 같아요... ㅠ 저도 뒹굴거리면서 힘든데, 길가면서 열심히 일하시는 어르신분이 쓰레기 치우시는거 보면... 얼마나 더 힘드실까... 반성하면서 "야 박성언 정신차리고 으앙으앙 거리지 말고 좀 조용히 감사하게 살아" 이런 별 생각이 나더라고욬ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ 하여튼... 제 마음에 제일 가깝고 간직한 부분을 나눌수 있어서 행복해요^^ 그리고 이런 제 이런 면도 나눌수 있는 너무나 착하고 사랑스러운 구독자들...ㅠ 이런 개인적인 면도 나눌수 있게 언제나 제 모든 면을 받아주시고, 편안함을 주셔서 감사합니다. 힘드신 이눔의 2020!!!! 그래도 우리의 영원한 희망을 바라보면서 같이 해냅시다! 한국어 너무 어려워요 ㅋㅋㅋㅋ 감정 표현을 풍부히 못하겠는데... 내 마음 알G? (하트 뽕뽕~~)

니콜/ 스범이가

- "오직 나는 여호와를 우러러보며 나를 구원하시는 하나님을 바라보나니 나의 하나님이 나를 들으시리로다" - 미가 7:7
- '그러므로 내가 그리스도를 위하여 약한 것들과 능욕과 궁핍과 핍박과 곤란을 기뻐하노니 이는 내가 약할 그 때에 곧 강함이니라 ' - 고린도후서 12:10
- '여호와여 내가 심히 깊은 구덩이에서 주의 이름을 불렀나이다 주께서 이미 나의 음성을 들으셨사오니 이제 나의 탄식과 부르짖음에 주의 귀를 가리우지 마옵소서 내가 주께 아뢴 날에 주께서 내게 가까이 하여 가라사대 두려워 말라 하셨나이다 '- 예레미야애가 3:55-57

+ I'm speaking softly so that those watching can relax/wind down, fall asleep, or experience ASMR.

What is ASMR?
+ ASMR(Autonomous Sensory Meridian Response) is an experience or reaction from psychological relaxation or pleasant stimuli. It is a tingly experience characterized by a static-like or tingling sensation on the skin that typically begins on the scalp and moves down the back of the neck and upper spine, precipitating relaxation. Though it is usually a tingly feeling, it is also sometimes a feeling of sleepiness. 

Why listen to ASMR?
+ I personally started listening to it my junior year in high school when I could not sleep from stress. Many people who struggle with insomnia or distributive sleeping patterns listen to ASMR. Of course, there are some who watch and listen to feel relaxed or experience brain tingles.

Hi guys!! Really quickly, thank you for being incredibly patient with me and this channel. Your comments come up on my notifciations and I read all of them now days since the number of comments have gone down 😂 

Quick back story. 
I have a congenital heart condition called Tetralogy of Fallot. It's a baby blue defect from birth. I have been lucky enough to have had really great doctors growing up. I ended up attending the university that my paediatric cardiologist, Dr. James Lock graduated from. My heart condition is a really cool story that I have been able to share with friends and it's really molded me into the person I have become and am becoming.
I am currently taking time off of school to get hopefully a valve replacement which is why I'm back in England with my family :) 

I wanted to say thank you so much for watching my videos and supporting me through such kind words in the comments. They're hilarious and uplifting and I could not be more grateful...

To end this letter, here is a picture of the email I sent to my pediatric cardiologist, Dr. James Lock, as a high school senior. I was so young when he helped me I never got to say thank you. Looking back at the email now, it still really comforts me. With our current events in the world, I think it's an easy time to feel discouraged.  I hope that the email exchanges below can be a reminder of hope and revival for any trepidation or challenges that may come in the future.
 
Sending love, gratitude and my bestestest wishes 
Nicole

snippet.title: ASMR whispered Memebox Review!
snippet.description:
Hey guys!

Promo code that Memebox gave: F06MOQ
(it's $5 discount!!!) valid through August 2014

So a few weeks ago, Memebox, a Korean subscription box that offers Korean or Asian beauty products got in touch with me to ask if I wanted review their box. They sent me one of their boxes and I decided to review it.

I get a few emails from companies asking to review things but I normally won't reply because 1. I can't be bothered 2. I don't think my viewers would really like the products they offer or 3. I feel like if I had to give a honest review, it might not be the best one...

However, I know a lot of my viewers are females who are interested in beauty products and getting Asian beauty products might be difficult globally. 

I'm not sure how they get past legal things with liquids and things like that but their boxes are pretty awesome and are fully packed. 

I've done monthly subscription boxes before and compared to my past experiences, I really like this company.

I will be buying a few more of their boxes while I'm in Korea :) 
(Probably box #17 and "girls night out" box)

Anyway, I hope you guys enjoy this whispered review.

snippet.title: ASMR Psalm 1-16/ 시편 1-16장 (Bible Reading to help you sleep)
snippet.description:
💖 Hi friends! I hope you guys are staying safe and healthy. 
So... crazy times eh? hahaha I cannot believe it's already July of 2020, wth, where did the time go? This year has been a strange one... I can only guess that so many of you guys have been affected by the current state of the world. With the U.S. elections coming up, COVID-19, the racial issues in the States, and many other world crises that I don't even know about, I hope this video can provide a way to help you guys fall asleep... and I hope and pray that in the midst of difficulties, you can be reminded to look up to the one God who cares for you and wants you to come to His feet and find rest in His loving presence. The past few days, I have been reminded that God desires our childlike emotions and wants us to draw to Him even when we feel like complaining and can't always praise him. I am so thankful that God has allowed me to provide a place where I can share the most intimate and cherished parts of myself. While I may not know you guys personally, so many of you guys kindly update me on your lives and I feel like I am longtime friends with a lot of you. Thank you for making me feel comfortable enough to share these moments with you and for always being the most drama-free, loyal, wonderful, kind-hearted subscribers a gal could ever wish for!

- "But as for me, I watch in hope for the Lord, I wait for God my Savior; my God will hear me." - Micah 7:7
- "That is why, for Christ's sake, I delight in weaknesses, in insults, in hardships, in persecutions, in difficulties. For when I am weak, then I am strong." - 2 Corinthians 12:10
- "I called on your name, Lord, from the depths of the pit. You heard my plea: 'Do not close your ears to my cry for relief.' You came near when I called you, and You said, 'Do not fear.'" - Lamentations 3:55-57
- "The Lord will fulfill his purpose for me; Your steadfast love, O Lord, endures forever. Do not forsake the work of your hands." - Psalm 138:8

With love,
Nicole/ Pigsbum

localized.description:
💖 Hi friends! I hope you guys are staying safe and healthy. 
So... crazy times eh? hahaha I cannot believe it's already July of 2020, wth, where did the time go? This year has been a strange one... I can only guess that so many of you guys have been affected by the current state of the world. With the U.S. elections coming up, COVID-19, the racial issues in the States, and many other world crises that I don't even know about, I hope this video can provide a way to help you guys fall asleep... and I hope and pray that in the midst of difficulties, you can be reminded to look up to the one God who cares for you and wants you to come to His feet and find rest in His loving presence. The past few days, I have been reminded that God desires our childlike emotions and wants us to draw to Him even when we feel like complaining and can't always praise him. I am so thankful that God has allowed me to provide a place where I can share the most intimate and cherished parts of myself. While I may not know you guys personally, so many of you guys kindly update me on your lives and I feel like I am longtime friends with a lot of you. Thank you for making me feel comfortable enough to share these moments with you and for always being the most drama-free, loyal, wonderful, kind-hearted subscribers a gal could ever wish for!

- "But as for me, I watch in hope for the Lord, I wait for God my Savior; my God will hear me." - Micah 7:7

With love,

snippet.title: [ASMR] Whispering Show and Tell (Scratching, Tapping, Mouth Sounds etc)
snippet.description:
I show you things! Happy first day of May (March, sorry my b)

+ Non-ASMR Channel: https://goo.gl/GOzFqK
+ Twitter: https://twitter.com/nicolesupark/
+Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/nicolesupark/ (personal)
https://www.instagram.com/pigsbum53asmr/ (ASMR related)

email: pigsbum53@gmail.com

=================================================

Why are you whispering? 
+ I'm speaking softly so that those watching can relax/wind down, fall asleep, or experience ASMR.

What is ASMR?
+ ASMR(Autonomous Sensory Meridian Response) is an experience or reaction from psychological relaxation or pleasant stimuli. It is a tingly experience characterized by a static-like or tingling sensation on the skin that typically begins on the scalp and moves down the back of the neck and upper spine, precipitating relaxation. Though it is usually a tingly feeling, it is also sometimes a feeling of sleepiness. 

Why listen to ASMR?
+ I personally started listening to it my junior year in high school when I could not sleep from stress. Many people who struggle with insomnia or distributive sleeping patterns listen to ASMR. Of course, there are some who watch and listen to feel relaxed or experience brain tingles.

Can you suggest videos?
+ Welcome to the Tingle Fam! This community is huge and there are a ton of videos to watch. Take your time and explore the community and have fun finding your triggers!
Here are a few ordinary ones that I enjoyed as a child-
Toy Story Woody Cleaning: 
https://goo.gl/KoP780
Scenes from the movie "Matilda"
Poppin Cookin Videos: 
https://goo.gl/oZgQe
My most watched videos playlist: https://goo.gl/pwd5rZ


(This was filmed around December or early Jan i forget the exact date)

snippet.title: | ASMR | Colouring and Whispering + Updates
snippet.description:
Hi!!!!!!!!!!!!

LONG TIME NO TALK SEE SMELL HEAR!

Hope you guys have been well :) Here's a good old whispering video to start off my rusty limbs of YouTube. (◕‿◕✿)

+ Non-ASMR Channel: https://goo.gl/GOzFqK
+ Twitter: https://twitter.com/nicolesupark/
+ Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/nicolesupark/ (personal)
https://www.instagram.com/pigsbum53asmr/ (ASMR related)
Email: pigsbum53@gmail.com

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Edit: took the donation link down! But feel free to still read the story 

Hi guys!! Really quickly, thank you for being incredibly patient with me and this channel. Your comments come up on my notifciations and I read all of them now days since the number of comments have gone down 😂 

Quick back story. 
I have a congenital heart condition called Tetralogy of Fallot. It's a baby blue defect from birth. I have been lucky enough to have had really great doctors growing up. I ended up attending the university that my paediatric cardiologist, Dr. James Lock graduated from. My heart condition is a really cool story that I have been able to share with friends and it's really molded me into the person I have become and am becoming.
I am currently taking time off of school to get hopefully a valve replacement which is why I'm back in England with my family :) 

I wanted to say thank you so much for watching my videos and supporting me through such kind words in the comments. They're hilarious and uplifting and I could not be more grateful...

To end this letter, here is a picture of the email I sent to my pediatric cardiologist, Dr. James Lock, as a high school senior. I was so young when he helped me I never got to say thank you. Looking back at the email now, it still really comforts me. With our current events in the world, I think it's an easy time to feel discouraged.  I hope that the email exchanges below can be a reminder of hope and revival for any trepidation or challenges that may come in the future.
 
Sending love, gratitude and my bestestest wishes 
Nicole

picture of my email and his response:
http://imgur.com/gallery/C252S

Hi guys!! Really quickly, thank you for being incredibly patient with me and this channel. Your comments come up on my notifciations and I read all of them now days since the number of comments have gone down 😂 

Quick back story. 
I have a congenital heart condition called Tetralogy of Fallot. It's a baby blue defect from birth. I have been lucky enough to have had really great doctors growing up. I ended up attending the university that my paediatric cardiologist, Dr. James Lock graduated from. My heart condition is a really cool story that I have been able to share with friends and it's really molded me into the person I have become and am becoming.
I am currently taking time off of school to get hopefully a valve replacement which is why I'm back in England with my family :) 

I wanted to say thank you so much for watching my videos and supporting me through such kind words in the comments. They're hilarious and uplifting and I could not be more grateful...

To end this letter, here is a picture of the email I sent to my pediatric cardiologist, Dr. James Lock, as a high school senior. I was so young when he helped me I never got to say thank you. Looking back at the email now, it still really comforts me. With our current events in the world, I think it's an easy time to feel discouraged.  I hope that the email exchanges below can be a reminder of hope and revival for any trepidation or challenges that may come in the future.
 
Sending love, gratitude and my bestestest wishes 
Nicole

picture of my email and his response:
http://imgur.com/gallery/C252S
(You may need to zoom in on my email, i needed to fit it into one page whoops)


=================================================

Why are you whispering? 
+ I'm speaking softly so that those watching can relax/wind down, fall asleep, or experience ASMR.

What is ASMR?
+ ASMR(Autonomous Sensory Meridian Response) is an experience or reaction from psychological relaxation or pleasant stimuli. It is a tingly experience characterized by a static-like or tingling sensation on the skin that typically begins on the scalp and moves down the back of the neck and upper spine, precipitating relaxation. Though it is usually a tingly feeling, it is also sometimes a feeling of sleepiness. 

Who & why listen to ASMR?
+ I personally started listening to it my junior year in high school when I could not sleep from stress. Many people who struggle with insomnia or distributive sleeping patterns listen to ASMR. Of course, there are some  who watch and listen to feel relaxed or experience brain tingles.

Can you suggest videos?
+ Welcome to the Tingle Fam! This community is huge and there are a ton of videos to watch. Take your time exploring the community and have fun finding your triggers!
Here are a few ordinary ones that I enjoyed as a child-
Toy Story Woody Cleaning: 
https://goo.gl/KoP780
Scenes from the movie "Matilda"

https://goo.gl/oZgQe

* Important: I am neither a medical professional nor qualified to give any sort of advice. If you are struggling with anxiety or depression, please reach out to professional help or those that will be able to help you accordingly.

https://www.imalive.org/
https://www.nami.org/

snippet.title: [VLOG/비디오 블로그] Christmas in London/영국 크리스마스 | Part 2/4 (Not ASMR)
snippet.description:
Part two of vlogmas!! Happy New Year guys!!!!!!! I sincerely hope 2015 is a blessed year for all of you :) Keep God close in your hearts and know that you are loved and are very precious :)

Love you lots, thank you so much for everything you guys have given me 2014 and the previous years. I am truly grateful to have the most supportive subscribers and friends ever!

1 Peter 4:8
"Above all, love each other deeply, because love covers over a multitude of sins."
♥ 

Lots and lots of Love,
Nicole
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

새 해 복 많이 받으세요!! ㅎㅎ 벌써 2014년이 쓩~ 지나갔네요...
이번 해에 한국분들이 더 많이 제 비디오를 봐주시는거 같은데, 제가 한국어가 좀 어설퍼서 한국어 ASMR 비디오 많이 못만들어서 죄송해요..ㅠ 2015년에는 더 욱더 많은 한국어 비디오들을 기대해주셔도 되요~

저를 언제나 이쁘게 봐주셔서 감사하고, 댓글을 너무 따뜻하고 밝게 써주셔서 진심으로 감사드려요 ㅎㅎ 어설픈 점들이 많지만, 제가 재미로 만드는 비디오들을 너무 칭찬해주셔서 진짜로 감사하고요...^^

다들 2015년도 풍성하고 아름다운 해가 되길 바라고, 하나님이 여러분 삶에 하나님의 은혜와 사랑을 퐉퐉!! 넣시길 바라고 기도합니다~~!!

베드로전서 4:8
"무엇보다도 열심으로 서로 사랑할찌니 사랑은 허다한 죄를 덮느니라"
♥ 

Lots and lots of 러브
니콜 :)
======

ar.title: [مدونة فيديو] عيد الميلاد في لندن | الجزء الثاني/الرابع (ليس استجابة الاستجابة الحسية الذاتية)
ar.description:
الجزء الثاني من فيديوهات عيد الميلاد!! عام جديد سعيد للجميع! أتمنى من كل قلبي أن يكون عام ٢٠١٥ عامًا مباركًا عليكم جميعًا :) ليكن الله قريبًا من قلوبكم، واعلموا أنكم محبوبون وثمينون جدًا :)

أحبكم كثيرًا، شكرًا جزيلًا لكم على كل ما قدمتموه لي في عام ٢٠١٤ والأعوام التي سبقته. أنا ممتنة حقًا لوجود أكثر المشتركين والأصدقاء دعمًا على الإطلاق!

رسالة بطرس الأولى ٤: ٨

"وقبل كل شيء، أحبوا بعضكم بعضًا حبًا عميقًا، لأن المحبة تستر كثرة من الخطايا."
♥

مع حبي الكبير،
نيكول
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

عام جديد سعيد!! ههه، مرّ عام ٢٠١٤ سريعًا...
يبدو أن عددًا أكبر من الكوريين يشاهدون فيديوهاتي هذا العام، لكنني آسف لأنني لم أتمكن من إنتاج العديد من فيديوهات ASMR الكورية لأن لغتي الكورية ليست جيدة جدًا... ㅠ يمكنكم التطلع إلى المزيد من الفيديوهات الكورية في عام ٢٠١٥~

شكرًا لكم على لطفكم الدائم، وأُقدّر بصدق تعليقاتكم الدافئة والمشرقة. ههه، على الرغم من وجود العديد من النواقص، إلا أنني ممتن حقًا للإطراءات على الفيديوهات التي أصنعها للمتعة... ^^

أتمنى أن يكون عام ٢٠١٥ عامًا وافرًا وجميلًا للجميع. أدعو الله أن يُفيض نعمته ومحبته في حياتكم!

pa.title: [VLOG/ਵੀਡੀਓ ਬਲੌਗ] ਲੰਡਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਮਸ | ਭਾਗ 2/4 (ASMR ਨਹੀਂ)
pa.description:
ਵਲੌਗਮਾਸ ਦਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਗ!! ਨਵਾਂ ਸਾਲ ਮੁਬਾਰਕ ਦੋਸਤੋ!!!!!!! ਮੈਨੂੰ ਪੂਰੀ ਉਮੀਦ ਹੈ ਕਿ 2015 ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਸਾਰਿਆਂ ਲਈ ਇੱਕ ਮੁਬਾਰਕ ਸਾਲ ਹੋਵੇ :) ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਨੂੰ ਆਪਣੇ ਦਿਲਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਰੱਖੋ ਅਤੇ ਜਾਣੋ ਕਿ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਹੋ ਅਤੇ ਬਹੁਤ ਕੀਮਤੀ ਹੋ :)

ਤੁਹਾਨੂੰ ਬਹੁਤ ਪਿਆਰ ਕਰਦਾ ਹਾਂ, 2014 ਅਤੇ ਪਿਛਲੇ ਸਾਲਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਜੋ ਕੁਝ ਮੈਨੂੰ ਦਿੱਤਾ ਹੈ ਉਸ ਲਈ ਤੁਹਾਡਾ ਬਹੁਤ ਧੰਨਵਾਦ। ਮੈਂ ਸੱਚਮੁੱਚ ਧੰਨਵਾਦੀ ਹਾਂ ਕਿ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਕੋਲ ਹੁਣ ਤੱਕ ਦੇ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਸਹਿਯੋਗੀ ਗਾਹਕ ਅਤੇ ਦੋਸਤ ਹਨ!

1 ਪਤਰਸ 4:8
“ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ, ਇੱਕ ਦੂਜੇ ਨੂੰ ਡੂੰਘਾ ਪਿਆਰ ਕਰੋ, ਕਿਉਂਕਿ ਪਿਆਰ ਬਹੁਤ ਸਾਰੇ ਪਾਪਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਢੱਕ ਲੈਂਦਾ ਹੈ।”

♥ 

ਬਹੁਤ ਸਾਰਾ ਪਿਆਰ,
ਨਿਕੋਲ
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

ਨਵਾਂ ਸਾਲ ਮੁਬਾਰਕ!! ਹਾਹਾ, 2014 ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਹੀ ਲੰਘ ਚੁੱਕਾ ਹੈ...
ਇੰਝ ਲੱਗਦਾ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਇਸ ਸਾਲ ਜ਼ਿਆਦਾ ਕੋਰੀਆਈ ਲੋਕ ਮੇਰੇ ਵੀਡੀਓ ਦੇਖ ਰਹੇ ਹਨ, ਪਰ ਮੈਨੂੰ ਅਫ਼ਸੋਸ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਮੈਂ ਬਹੁਤ ਸਾਰੇ ਕੋਰੀਆਈ ASMR ਵੀਡੀਓ ਨਹੀਂ ਬਣਾ ਸਕਿਆ ਕਿਉਂਕਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਕੋਰੀਆਈ ਬਹੁਤ ਵਧੀਆ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੈ...ㅠ ਤੁਸੀਂ 2015 ਵਿੱਚ ਹੋਰ ਵੀ ਕੋਰੀਆਈ ਵੀਡੀਓਜ਼ ਦੀ ਉਮੀਦ ਕਰ ਸਕਦੇ ਹੋ~

ਹਮੇਸ਼ਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਵੱਲ ਪਿਆਰ ਨਾਲ ਦੇਖਣ ਲਈ ਤੁਹਾਡਾ ਧੰਨਵਾਦ, ਅਤੇ ਮੈਂ ਤੁਹਾਡੀਆਂ ਨਿੱਘੀਆਂ ਅਤੇ ਚਮਕਦਾਰ ਟਿੱਪਣੀਆਂ ਦੀ ਦਿਲੋਂ ਕਦਰ ਕਰਦਾ ਹਾਂ। ਹਾਹਾ, ਭਾਵੇਂ ਬਹੁਤ ਸਾਰੀਆਂ ਕਮੀਆਂ ਹਨ, ਮੈਂ ਮਨੋਰੰਜਨ ਲਈ ਬਣਾਏ ਗਏ ਵੀਡੀਓਜ਼ 'ਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਸ਼ੰਸਾ ਲਈ ਸੱਚਮੁੱਚ ਧੰਨਵਾਦੀ ਹਾਂ...^^

ਮੈਨੂੰ ਉਮੀਦ ਹੈ ਕਿ 2015 ਸਾਰਿਆਂ ਲਈ ਇੱਕ ਭਰਪੂਰ ਅਤੇ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਸਾਲ ਹੋਵੇਗਾ। ਮੈਂ ਪ੍ਰਾਰਥਨਾ ਕਰਦਾ ਹਾਂ ਕਿ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਤੁਹਾਡੀ ਜ਼ਿੰਦਗੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਆਪਣੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਤੇ ਪਿਆਰ ਪਾਵੇ!!

1 ਪਤਰਸ 4:8
"ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ, ਇੱਕ ਦੂਜੇ ਨੂੰ ਡੂੰਘਾਈ ਨਾਲ ਪਿਆਰ ਕਰੋ, ਕਿਉਂਕਿ ਪਿਆਰ ਬਹੁਤ ਸਾਰੇ ਪਾਪਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਢੱਕ ਲੈਂਦਾ ਹੈ।"

id.description:
Bagian kedua dari vlogmas!! Selamat Tahun Baru, semuanya!!!!!!! Semoga tahun 2015 menjadi tahun yang penuh berkah bagi kalian semua :) Tetaplah dekatkan Tuhan di hati kalian dan ketahuilah bahwa kalian dicintai dan sangat berharga :)

Aku sangat menyayangi kalian, terima kasih banyak atas semua yang telah kalian berikan kepadaku di tahun 2014 dan tahun-tahun sebelumnya. Aku sungguh bersyukur memiliki pelanggan dan teman-teman yang paling suportif!

1 Petrus 4:8
“Tetapi yang terutama: kasihilah sungguh-sungguh seorang akan yang lain, sebab kasih menutupi banyak sekali dosa.”
♥ 

Banyak sekali kasih,
Nicole
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Selamat tahun baru!! Haha, 2014 sudah berlalu begitu cepat...
Sepertinya lebih banyak orang Korea yang menonton video saya tahun ini, tapi maaf saya tidak bisa membuat banyak video ASMR Korea karena bahasa Korea saya kurang bagus...ㅠ Nantikan lebih banyak video Korea di tahun 2015~

Terima kasih sudah selalu melihat saya dengan ramah, dan saya sangat menghargai komentar-komentar kalian yang hangat dan ceria. Haha, meskipun banyak kekurangan, saya sangat berterima kasih atas pujian untuk video-video yang saya buat untuk bersenang-senang...^^

Semoga 2015 menjadi tahun yang berlimpah dan indah bagi semua orang. Saya berdoa agar Tuhan mencurahkan kasih karunia dan kasih-Nya ke dalam hidup kalian!!

1 Petrus 4:8
"Yang terutama: kasihilah sungguh-sungguh seorang akan yang lain, sebab kasih menutupi banyak sekali dosa."

ta.description:
வ்லோக்மாஸின் இரண்டாம் பகுதி!! புத்தாண்டு வாழ்த்துக்கள் நண்பர்களே!!!!!! 2015 உங்கள் அனைவருக்கும் ஒரு ஆசீர்வதிக்கப்பட்ட ஆண்டாக இருக்கும் என்று நான் மனதார நம்புகிறேன் :) கடவுளை உங்கள் இதயங்களில் நெருக்கமாக வைத்திருங்கள், நீங்கள் மிகவும் நேசிக்கப்படுகிறீர்கள், மிகவும் விலைமதிப்பற்றவர்கள் என்பதை அறிந்து கொள்ளுங்கள் :)

உங்களை மிகவும் நேசிக்கிறேன், 2014 மற்றும் அதற்கு முந்தைய ஆண்டுகளில் நீங்கள் எனக்கு வழங்கிய அனைத்திற்கும் மிக்க நன்றி. இதுவரை இல்லாத அளவுக்கு ஆதரவான சந்தாதாரர்கள் மற்றும் நண்பர்களைப் பெற்றதற்கு நான் உண்மையிலேயே நன்றியுள்ளவனாக இருக்கிறேன்!

1 பேதுரு 4:8
“எல்லாவற்றிற்கும் மேலாக, ஒருவருக்கொருவர் ஆழமாக அன்பு செலுத்துங்கள், ஏனென்றால் அன்பு திரளான பாவங்களை மூடுகிறது.”
♥ 

நிறைய அன்பு,

நிக்கோல்
- ஹாஹா, 2014 ஏற்கனவே பறந்து விட்டது...
இந்த வருடம் அதிகமான கொரியர்கள் எனது வீடியோக்களைப் பார்ப்பது போல் தெரிகிறது, ஆனால் எனது கொரிய மொழி அவ்வளவு நன்றாக இல்லாததால் என்னால் அதிக கொரிய ASMR வீடியோக்களை உருவாக்க முடியவில்லை என்பது வருத்தமளிக்கிறது...ㅠ 2015 இல் இன்னும் அதிகமான கொரிய வீடியோக்களை நீங்கள் எதிர்நோக்கலாம்~

எப்போதும் என்னை அன்பாகப் பார்ப்பதற்கு நன்றி, மேலும் உங்கள் அன்பான மற்றும் பிரகாசமான கருத்துகளுக்கு நான் உண்மையிலேயே நன்றியுள்ளவனாக இருக்கிறேன். ஹாஹா, பல குறைபாடுகள் இருந்தாலும், நான் வேடிக்கைக்காக உருவாக்கும் வீடியோக்களுக்கான பாராட்டுக்களுக்கு நான் உண்மையிலேயே நன்றியுள்ளவனாக இருக்கிறேன்...^^

2015 அனைவருக்கும் ஒரு வளமான மற்றும் அழகான ஆண்டாக இருக்கும் என்று நம்புகிறேன். கடவுள் தனது கிருபையையும் அன்பையும் உங்கள் வாழ்க்கையில் பொழிவார் என்று நான் பிரார்த்திக்கிறேன்!!

1 பேதுரு 4:8
"எல்லாவற்றிற்கும் மேலாக, ஒருவருக்கொருவர் ஆழமாக அன்பு செலுத்துங்கள், ஏனென்றால் அன்பு திரளான பாவங்களை மூடுகிறது."

bn.description:
ভ্লগমাসের দ্বিতীয় অংশ!! শুভ নববর্ষ বন্ধুরা!!!!!!! আমি আন্তরিকভাবে আশা করি ২০১৫ সাল তোমাদের সকলের জন্য একটি আশীর্বাদপূর্ণ বছর হবে :) ঈশ্বরকে তোমাদের হৃদয়ে কাছে রাখো এবং জেনে রাখো যে তোমরা ভালোবাসা পাও এবং অত্যন্ত মূল্যবান :)

তোমাদের অনেক ভালোবাসি, ২০১৪ এবং তার আগের বছরগুলিতে তোমরা আমাকে যা কিছু দিয়েছ তার জন্য অনেক ধন্যবাদ। আমি সত্যিই কৃতজ্ঞ যে এখন পর্যন্ত সবচেয়ে বেশি সহায়ক গ্রাহক এবং বন্ধু পেয়েছি!

১ পিতর ৪:৮
“সর্বোপরি, একে অপরকে গভীরভাবে ভালোবাসো, কারণ ভালোবাসা অসংখ্য পাপকে ঢেকে রাখে।”

♥ 

অনেক ভালোবাসা,
নিকোল
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

শুভ নববর্ষ!! হা হা, ২০১৪ সাল তো কেটেই গেল...
মনে হচ্ছে এই বছর আরও বেশি কোরিয়ান আমার ভিডিও দেখছে, কিন্তু আমি দুঃখিত যে আমি অনেক কোরিয়ান ASMR ভিডিও তৈরি করতে পারিনি কারণ আমার কোরিয়ান ভাষা খুব একটা ভালো নয়...ㅠ ২০১৫ সালে আরও বেশি কোরিয়ান ভিডিওর জন্য অপেক্ষা করতে পারেন~

সবসময় আমার দিকে সদয়ভাবে তাকানোর জন্য আপনাকে ধন্যবাদ, এবং আপনার উষ্ণ এবং উজ্জ্বল মন্তব্যের জন্য আমি আন্তরিকভাবে কৃতজ্ঞ। হা হা, যদিও অনেক ত্রুটি রয়েছে, আমি মজা করার জন্য যে ভিডিওগুলি তৈরি করি তার প্রশংসার জন্য আমি সত্যিই কৃতজ্ঞ...^^

আমি আশা করি ২০১৫ সালটি সবার জন্য একটি সমৃদ্ধ এবং সুন্দর বছর হবে। আমি প্রার্থনা করি যে ঈশ্বর আপনার জীবনে তাঁর অনুগ্রহ এবং ভালবাসা ঢেলে দিন!!

১ পিতর ৪:৮
"সর্বোপরি, একে অপরকে গভীরভাবে ভালোবাসো, কারণ প্রেম অসংখ্য পাপকে ঢেকে দেয়।"

♥

pl.title: [VLOG/Wideoblog] Boże Narodzenie w Londynie | Część 2/4 (Nie ASMR)
pl.description:
Część druga vlogmasów!! Szczęśliwego Nowego Roku!!!!!!!! Mam szczerą nadzieję, że 2015 będzie dla Was wszystkich błogosławionym rokiem :) Trzymajcie Boga blisko w swoich sercach i wiedzcie, że jesteście kochani i bardzo cenni :)

Kocham Was bardzo, bardzo dziękuję za wszystko, co mi daliście w 2014 roku i w latach ubiegłych. Jestem naprawdę wdzięczna za to, że mam tak wspierających subskrybentów i przyjaciół!

1 Piotra 4:8
„Przede wszystkim miłujcie się wzajemnie, bo miłość zakrywa mnóstwo grzechów”.
♥

Mnóstwo, mnóstwo miłości,
Nicole
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Szczęśliwego Nowego Roku!! Haha, 2014 rok już przeleciał...
Wygląda na to, że w tym roku więcej Koreańczyków ogląda moje filmy, ale żałuję, że nie mogłam nagrać wielu koreańskich filmów ASMR, bo mój koreański nie jest zbyt dobry...ㅠ Możecie spodziewać się jeszcze więcej koreańskich filmów w 2015 roku~

Dziękuję, że zawsze patrzycie na mnie życzliwie i szczerze doceniam Wasze ciepłe i pogodne komentarze. Haha, mimo wielu niedociągnięć, jestem naprawdę wdzięczna za komplementy dotyczące filmów, które tworzę dla zabawy...^^

Mam nadzieję, że 2015 rok będzie obfity i piękny dla wszystkich. Modlę się, aby Bóg wylał swoją łaskę i miłość w wasze życie!!

1 Piotra 4:8
„Przede wszystkim miłujcie się wzajemnie gorąco, bo miłość zakrywa mnóstwo grzechów”.
♥

Mnóstwo, mnóstwo miłości
Nicole :)

ko.title: [VLOG/비디오 블로그] Christmas in London/영국 크리스마스 | Part 2/4 (Not ASMR)
ko.description:
Part two of vlogmas!! Happy New Year guys!!!!!!! I sincerely hope 2015 is a blessed year for all of you :) Keep God close in your hearts and know that you are loved and are very precious :)

Love you lots, thank you so much for everything you guys have given me 2014 and the previous years. I am truly grateful to have the most supportive subscribers and friends ever!

1 Peter 4:8
"Above all, love each other deeply, because love covers over a multitude of sins."
♥ 

Lots and lots of Love,
Nicole
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

새 해 복 많이 받으세요!! ㅎㅎ 벌써 2014년이 쓩~ 지나갔네요...
이번 해에 한국분들이 더 많이 제 비디오를 봐주시는거 같은데, 제가 한국어가 좀 어설퍼서 한국어 ASMR 비디오 많이 못만들어서 죄송해요..ㅠ 2015년에는 더 욱더 많은 한국어 비디오들을 기대해주셔도 되요~

저를 언제나 이쁘게 봐주셔서 감사하고, 댓글을 너무 따뜻하고 밝게 써주셔서 진심으로 감사드려요 ㅎㅎ 어설픈 점들이 많지만, 제가 재미로 만드는 비디오들을 너무 칭찬해주셔서 진짜로 감사하고요...^^

다들 2015년도 풍성하고 아름다운 해가 되길 바라고, 하나님이 여러분 삶에 하나님의 은혜와 사랑을 퐉퐉!! 넣시길 바라고 기도합니다~~!!

hi.title: [VLOG/वीडियो ब्लॉग] लंदन में क्रिसमस | भाग 2/4 (ASMR नहीं)
hi.description:
व्लॉगमास का दूसरा भाग!! नव वर्ष की हार्दिक शुभकामनाएँ दोस्तों!!!!!!! मैं ईमानदारी से आशा करती हूँ कि 2015 आप सभी के लिए एक धन्य वर्ष हो :) ईश्वर को अपने दिलों में बसाएँ और जानें कि आप सभी प्रिय हैं और बहुत अनमोल हैं :)

आप सभी से बहुत प्यार करती हूँ, 2014 और पिछले वर्षों में आपने मुझे जो कुछ भी दिया है, उसके लिए बहुत-बहुत धन्यवाद। मैं सचमुच आभारी हूँ कि मुझे अब तक के सबसे सहायक सब्सक्राइबर और दोस्त मिले हैं!

1 पतरस 4:8
“सबसे बढ़कर, एक-दूसरे से गहरा प्रेम रखो, क्योंकि प्रेम अनेक पापों को ढाँप देता है।”
♥

ढेर सारा प्यार,
निकोल
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

नव वर्ष की शुभकामनाएँ!! हाहा, 2014 तो उड़ ही गया...
लगता है इस साल ज़्यादा कोरियाई लोग मेरे वीडियो देख रहे हैं, लेकिन मुझे अफ़सोस है कि मैं ज़्यादा कोरियाई ASMR वीडियो नहीं बना पाई क्योंकि मेरी कोरियाई भाषा बहुत अच्छी नहीं है...ㅠ 2015 में आप और भी ज़्यादा कोरियाई वीडियो देखने की उम्मीद कर सकते हैं~

मुझ पर हमेशा प्यार से नज़र रखने के लिए शुक्रिया, और मैं आपकी गर्मजोशी और सकारात्मक टिप्पणियों की तहे दिल से कद्र करती हूँ। हाहा, हालाँकि मुझमें कई कमियाँ हैं, फिर भी मैं अपने मनोरंजन के लिए बनाए गए वीडियो पर मिलने वाली तारीफ़ों के लिए दिल से शुक्रगुज़ार हूँ...^^

मुझे उम्मीद है कि 2015 सभी के लिए एक भरपूर और खूबसूरत साल होगा। मैं प्रार्थना करती हूँ कि ईश्वर आप सभी के जीवन में अपनी कृपा और प्रेम उंडेलें!!

1 पतरस 4:8
"सबसे बढ़कर, एक-दूसरे से गहरा प्रेम रखो, क्योंकि प्रेम अनेक पापों को ढाँप देता है।"

iw.title: [וולוג/בלוג וידאו] חג המולד בלונדון | חלק 2/4 (לא ASMR)
iw.description:
חלק שני של וולוגמס!! שנה טובה חברים!!!!!! אני מקווה בכנות ש-2015 תהיה שנה מבורכת לכולכם :) שמרו את אלוהים קרוב בלבכם ודעו שאתם אהובים ויקרים מאוד :)

אוהבת אתכם המון, תודה רבה על כל מה שנתתם לי ב-2014 ובשנים שקדמו לכך. אני באמת אסירת תודה שיש לי את המנויים והחברים התומכים ביותר אי פעם!

פטרוס א' ד':8
"מעל הכל, אהבו זה את זה מאוד, כי האהבה מכסה על הרבה חטאים."
♥

המון המון אהבה,
ניקול
- ...

שנה טובה!! חה חה, 2014 כבר חלפה...
נראה שיותר קוריאנים צופים בסרטונים שלי השנה, אבל אני מצטער שלא יכולתי לעשות הרבה סרטוני ASMR קוריאניים כי הקוריאנית שלי לא טובה במיוחד...ㅠ אתם יכולים לצפות לעוד סרטונים קוריאניים ב-2015~

תודה שאתם תמיד מסתכלים עליי בחום, ואני מעריך בכנות את התגובות החמות והמבריקות שלכם. חה חה, למרות שיש הרבה חסרונות, אני באמת אסיר תודה על המחמאות על הסרטונים שאני עושה בשביל הכיף...^^

אני מקווה ש-2015 תהיה שנה שופעת ויפה לכולם. אני מתפלל שאלוהים ישפוך את חסדו ואהבתו לחיכם!!

ml.title: [VLOG/വീഡിയോ ബ്ലോഗ്] ലണ്ടനിലെ ക്രിസ്മസ് | ഭാഗം 2/4 (ASMR അല്ല)
ml.description:
വ്ലോഗ്മാസിന്റെ രണ്ടാം ഭാഗം!! പുതുവത്സരാശംസകൾ!!!!!!! 2015 നിങ്ങൾക്കെല്ലാവർക്കും അനുഗ്രഹീതമായ ഒരു വർഷമായിരിക്കുമെന്ന് ഞാൻ ആത്മാർത്ഥമായി പ്രതീക്ഷിക്കുന്നു :) ദൈവത്തെ നിങ്ങളുടെ ഹൃദയങ്ങളിൽ അടുപ്പിച്ചു നിർത്തുക, നിങ്ങൾ സ്നേഹിക്കപ്പെടുന്നുവെന്നും വളരെ വിലപ്പെട്ടവരാണെന്നും അറിയുക :)

നിങ്ങളെ ഒരുപാട് സ്നേഹിക്കുന്നു, 2014 ലും മുൻ വർഷങ്ങളിലും നിങ്ങൾ എനിക്ക് നൽകിയ എല്ലാത്തിനും വളരെ നന്ദി. ഇതുവരെയുള്ളതിൽ വച്ച് ഏറ്റവും പിന്തുണ നൽകുന്ന സബ്‌സ്‌ക്രൈബർമാരെയും സുഹൃത്തുക്കളെയും ലഭിച്ചതിൽ ഞാൻ ശരിക്കും നന്ദിയുള്ളവനാണ്!

1 പത്രോസ് 4:8
“എല്ലാറ്റിനുമുപരി, പരസ്പരം ആഴമായി സ്നേഹിക്കുക, കാരണം സ്നേഹം പാപങ്ങളുടെ ബഹുത്വത്തെ മറയ്ക്കുന്നു.”
♥ 

ധാരാളം സ്നേഹം,
നിക്കോൾ
- ഹഹ, 2014 ഇതിനകം കടന്നുപോയി...
ഈ വർഷം കൂടുതൽ കൊറിയക്കാർ എന്റെ വീഡിയോകൾ കാണുന്നുണ്ടെന്ന് തോന്നുന്നു, പക്ഷേ എന്റെ കൊറിയൻ അത്ര നല്ലതല്ലാത്തതിനാൽ എനിക്ക് ധാരാളം കൊറിയൻ ASMR വീഡിയോകൾ നിർമ്മിക്കാൻ കഴിയാത്തതിൽ ഞാൻ ഖേദിക്കുന്നു...ㅠ 2015-ൽ നിങ്ങൾക്ക് കൂടുതൽ കൊറിയൻ വീഡിയോകൾ പ്രതീക്ഷിക്കാം~

എപ്പോഴും എന്നെ ദയയോടെ നോക്കിയതിന് നന്ദി, നിങ്ങളുടെ ഊഷ്മളവും തിളക്കമുള്ളതുമായ അഭിപ്രായങ്ങൾക്ക് ഞാൻ ആത്മാർത്ഥമായി നന്ദിയുള്ളവനാണ്. ഹഹ, നിരവധി പോരായ്മകൾ ഉണ്ടെങ്കിലും, വിനോദത്തിനായി ഞാൻ നിർമ്മിക്കുന്ന വീഡിയോകളിലെ അഭിനന്ദനങ്ങൾക്ക് ഞാൻ ശരിക്കും നന്ദിയുള്ളവനാണ്...^^

2015 എല്ലാവർക്കും സമൃദ്ധവും മനോഹരവുമായ ഒരു വർഷമായിരിക്കുമെന്ന് ഞാൻ പ്രതീക്ഷിക്കുന്നു. ദൈവം തന്റെ കൃപയും സ്നേഹവും നിങ്ങളുടെ ജീവിതത്തിലേക്ക് പകരട്ടെ എന്ന് ഞാൻ പ്രാർത്ഥിക്കുന്നു!!

snippet.title: ASMR whispered Memebox Review!
snippet.description:
Hey guys!

Promo code that Memebox gave: F06MOQ
(it's $5 discount!!!) valid through August 2014

So a few weeks ago, Memebox, a Korean subscription box that offers Korean or Asian beauty products got in touch with me to ask if I wanted review their box. They sent me one of their boxes and I decided to review it.

I get a few emails from companies asking to review things but I normally won't reply because 1. I can't be bothered 2. I don't think my viewers would really like the products they offer or 3. I feel like if I had to give a honest review, it might not be the best one...

However, I know a lot of my viewers are females who are interested in beauty products and getting Asian beauty products might be difficult globally. 

I'm not sure how they get past legal things with liquids and things like that but their boxes are pretty awesome and are fully packed. 

I've done monthly subscription boxes before and compared to my past experiences, I really like this company.

I will be buying a few more of their boxes while I'm in Korea :) 
(Probably box #17 and "girls night out" box)

Anyway, I hope you guys enjoy this whispered review.

Memebox: http://us.memebox.com/memebox-global
